title: SpaceX may spend up to $119B on ‘Terafab’ chip factory in Texas
brief: SpaceX is planning to invest up to $119 billion on a massive semiconductor manufacturing facility called "Terafab" in Texas to build next-generation chips and advanced computing systems in-house. The project would be a vertically integrated facility enabling SpaceX to reduce dependence on external chip suppliers for its Starship and Starlink operations.
